s-1.ptxt: Inspect Power Window Regulator Motor Assembly

s2.ptxt: Power Window Regulator Motor Assembly (Driver Side, Rear LH) Operation Inspection

item.ptxt: Do not apply voltage to any terminals other than terminal 2 of the motor, as the pulse sensor inside the motor will be damaged.

After installing the power window regulator motor and regulator assembly to the door and completing reassembly of the door, be sure to perform the power window regulator motor registration setting (pulse sensor reset). (see )

s3.ptxt: Apply voltage to each terminal of the power window regulator motor assembly (driver side, rear LH) connector, and check that the power window regulator motor assembly (driver side, rear LH) operates smoothly.

entry.ptxt: Rotates clockwise relative to drive shaft
Rotates counterclockwise relative to drive shaft
